name: sintese-playmaker
description: Notices when there is enough parallelizable work, offers to run it with the agent CLIs you already have installed (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini/Antigravity, Copilot), and coordinates the workers through git worktrees and Lore.

proactive.title: Proactive offers
proactive.description: Let Playmaker nudge Claude to offer parallel execution when many tasks are open. Turn off to use only the /sintese-playmaker:orchestrate skill on demand.

min_tasks.title: Open tasks before nudging
min_tasks.description: How many open tasks in the session task list trigger the nudge.
